notes_for_editor: Only one dated source: the July 28, 1932 Teton Valley News item, quoted secondhand on westlookouts.weebly.com; the original was not found. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the peak under its Unknown/Undocumented Sites heading, with coordinates. A searched-for guide (willhiteweb.com fire_towers_225) reportedly lists a temporary Mount Chittenden entry, but I only saw it in a search snippet and did not read it, so it is not cited. Brief status 'unknown' is kept. The NPS history gives Coffman's two-lookout count with no year, so the 1929 date from the first draft was dropped and the story says only that the count is smaller. Staffing, structure and current remains are not in any readable source. The story's 'today' sentence is an absence claim and carries no footnote. Story is about 240 words.
